design: Replaces V30 f198-f336 (rays from f212-f214 on) and V31 f0-f28 (the same wide, rays) with one clip. V31 f24 is a hard cut to a close shot with a clean head; the take then resumes at V31 f29 (5 frames of that close shot are consumed, so the cut moves 0.2 s later; the narration lock only needs equal lengths: 139 + 29 = 168 frames = 7 s). The end pin V30 f203 is a clean frame of the same wide view as the first pin and stands in for the end of the wide before the cut.
